data.severity: medium; 14 of 18 applicable scenarios have complete evidence, with four defined coverage gaps
data.impact_scope: Potentially affects users relying on the complete default/install/profile/CLI precedence chain, untested enum and unsupported-option cases, Linux/WSL paths, and real sample-copy workflows; execution evidence is Windows local loopback mock only
data.estimated_repair_time: Approximately 0.5–1 working day for focused precedence, enum, and unsupported-option checks; cross-platform and real installation-copy verification depends on environment and install-path availability
data.delivery_impact: The bounded gaps do not prevent transition to independent Reviewer; preserve them as explicit risks, and supplement before release if Linux/WSL or real installation-path evidence is required
data.rationale: The event-bound report records 21 of 21 behavior tests passed with zero failures and 14 of 18 scenarios fully covered. S05 validates malformed TOML failure without partial output; S17/S18 validate invalid-value fallback and ignoring unknown keys, consistent with the stated configuration behavior. S08, S09, S14, and S15 remain incomplete and should not be represented as passed.
data.residual_risk: Full default-to-install precedence, complete enum validation, all unsupported options, copy/no-overwrite behavior, cross-platform behavior, real API behavior, and branch coverage remain unverified
data.uncertainty: Static review only; no commands run and coverage not independently recalculated. Release scope, target platform matrix, and real installation workflow are unspecified.
